column1: # THE 42 COMMANDS, and what each one runs. `42 help` is printed from this file,
# and //tools:conventions holds it to tools/BUILD.bazel: every run target there
# (sh_binary, py_binary) and every project's :generate is named in a row's RUNS,
# and every label a row names exists. A new action is a Bazel target plus one
# row here; a target nobody may run from 42 gets an `internal` row that says
#   COMMAND    the word after `42`; `-` for a target that is no command
#   USAGE      what follows the command word in `42 help`
#   AUDIENCE   student (in `42 help`), maintainer (in `42 help --all`), internal
#   TEXT       one line of help; for an internal row, the reason
